description: Capture a bounded recording from one exact input device through the audio-device worker environment. Success emits a signed 16-bit PCM WAV artifact plus microphone.capture.result evidence; permission, device, stream, silence, and size outcomes remain explicit.

host.description: Optional exact CPAL host name. Omit it to use the platform default host.

device_name.description: Optional exact input device name. Omit it to use the selected host's default input device.

max_duration_ms.description: Hard upper bound for this recording.

minimum_duration_ms.description: Minimum evidence duration before silence may stop the recording.

stop_after_silence_ms.description: Optional continuous below-threshold duration that ends capture after minimum_duration_ms.

silence_threshold_dbfs.description: Optional silence threshold in dBFS; used only with stop_after_silence_ms.
